en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical academic building with a mansard roof and landscaped gardens in front. Groups of students are walking down steps and along paths; a lamppost with globes is visible. The back side reads in Romanian that it is from the People's Republic of Romania and identifies the place as the medical‑pharmaceutical institute in Târgu Mureș.
